findings.title: Blank-input rejection is untested

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: An implementation that writes blank values and returns Saved would pass the supplied suite.
findings.correction: Add a public save test with whitespace-only input that asserts Invalid and no write calls.

findings.title: Pending interval uses itself as the expected value

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Returning false or an incorrect interval consistently for pending while not writing passes this test and every other supplied assertion.
findings.correction: Assert that poll('pending', false) equals the independent contractual value 5000.
